request.query: A nonzero polynomial has a Hasse derivative nonzero at a point with weight below any strict upper bound for its index

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_lt_natDegree
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), p.natDegree < n → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p = 0

items.name: Polynomial.degree_derivative_lt
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, p ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.derivative p).degree < p.degree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - n

items.name: MvPolynomial.weightedTotalDegree'_eq_bot_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : SemilatticeSup M] (w : σ → M) (p : MvPolynomial σ R), MvPolynomial.weightedTotalDegree' w p = ⊥ ↔ p = 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_C
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (r : R), 0 < k → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) (Polynomial.C r) = 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_one
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.hasseDeriv 1 = Polynomial.derivative
